messages:
Sam Patel: Hey infra — onboarding a new 'subscriber' org (acct 123456789012). Need GPU quota entitlements in af-south-1 and eu-west-3 for pilot next week. Can someone open support cases and coordinate ENI/SNAT increases?

Jorge Rivera: I can do the support cases. Paste the exact account IDs + desired ceilings and preferred AZs and I'll split them per region/family.

Sam Patel: account: 123456789012. Preferred AZs: af-south-1a/b, eu-west-3a. Target quotas (initial ask):
```
- p5.24xlarge: current 8 -> request 40
- p4d.24xlarge: current 2 -> request 8
- g5.48xlarge: current 10 -> request 30
- ENI (vpc-ipv4 addresses): current 500 -> request 2000
- SNAT/EIP pool: increase by 50
```
Justification: pilot runs 24/7 for 3 months with both training and steady inference; revenue-backed PO. Will follow up with business justification doc.

Maya Chen: Add that we'll run canary + warm pools and expect ~10% qtr growth after pilot. Also note we'll probably convert some to Dedicated (reserved) in Q3. That helps approvals.

Li Wang: Opening cases now. I'll create one case per region + accelerator family to avoid auto-rejections. Tagging with Redwood-Quota and cc @eng-infra.

infra-bot: Support case 987654321 opened by Li Wang for af-south-1 (p5/g5) — status: awaiting AWS review. ETA 48h.

Jorge Rivera: Thumbs up. Do we also need a subnet plan? The VPC in af-south-1 is currently /22 which won't scale to ENI=2000.

Sam Patel: Yes — networking already approved moving to /20, netops has the change queued. I'll cc netops and share the subnet plan.

Maya Chen: Quick cost sanity check: if we fully use the requested quota (on-demand list prices), monthly GPU cost ~= $340k (rough estimate). We'll mix reserved capacity for predictable parts.

Li Wang: AWS replied to case 987654321: "We can uplift p5 -> 40 and g5 -> 30 in af-south-1 pending the justification docs. p4d -> 8 requires entitlements review and formal business case." I'll paste their reply.

Li Wang: (paste) ```AWS: To proceed with p4d increases we require evidence of expected sustained usage and a contact for a billing review. Please attach a PO or contract and detailed usage profile.```

Sam Patel: I'll upload the PO and workload profile this morning. Also marking this as high priority for the pilot.

AWS Support: Case 987654321: ENI quota increased to 2000 in af-south-1; SNAT/EIP increase requested and under review. Further updates will be posted to the case.

Jorge Rivera: Nice. Once p5/g5 are approved we should coordinate capacity placement to avoid noisy neighbor across AZs — I'll add an affinity constraint in the provisioning matrix.

Maya Chen: Also consider enabling instance tagging and cost center to make reserved conversion easier later.

Sam Patel: Thanks team. Li, can you follow up on p4d entitlement steps and escalate if needed? I'll drop the justification into the AWS case.

Li Wang: Will do. If AWS asks for a letter I have the template from previous entitlements.

infra-bot: Support case 987654321 updated: "Customer uploaded business justification" — AWS analyst assigned.

Sam Patel: Marking this thread done for now. I'll post any AWS replies here and notify netops once the /20 is live. :thumbsup:
